fact: The document states the 5th national population and housing census (RGPH) was enumerated in November to December 2019, counting 20,505,155 residents.
INSD published the key final results (definitive results) of the 5th RGPH in June 2022.
ONI's director general cites the latest census, RGPH 2019, as the population base, giving 12,477,149 inhabitants aged 15 and over.
ONI's Director General cites the latest population and housing census, RGPH 2019, as the source of Burkina Faso's population aged 15 and over (12,477,149).
